title: HB 51 (2009 Regular Session): Voter ID; require to be shown before being allowed to vote.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec. 1(1) (23-15-541)
(quote) the manager shall identify the voter, in the presence and view of the bystanders, by requiring the voter to submit a valid Mississippi driver's license, an identification card issued by the Department of Public Safety, a voter registration card, a Medicaid or Medicare card, a health insurance card, a tax receipt or other identification card or by comparison with descriptive information on the pollbook or by having a person from the precinct vouch for the person's identification;
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) Sec. 1(2): curbside voting for physically disabled voters after the poll manager verifies identity
(other) Preclearance and effective date sections
